content: Harry Halliday (born on March 29, 1855, in Nottingham, England – December 9, 1937), was an English cricketer who played one first-class cricket match for Nottinghamshire against Kent at Trent Bridge in July 1878. He did not bat in the only innings of the match, which Nottinghamshire won by an innings and 75 runs. He only bowled once, but did not take any wickets. There is little more information available on his life or career.
